1	"""Run the leveraged-return model over window definitions in Spark, then summarize, pair and check.
2	
3	Usage:
4	    uv run python -m etf_risk.spark_pipeline --windows data/windows/full-2026-10-12/rolling-252-s21
5	    (for timed runs, start it through etf_risk.measure, which also records peak memory)
6	
7	Input:  a window-definition folder from etf_risk.windows (windows.parquet + config.json) and
8	        the return files of the snapshot named in its config. Every SHA-256 recorded in the
9	        config is verified before Spark starts; a mismatch stops the run.
10	Output: data/outputs/windows/<snapshot>/<definitions name>/<run id>/
11	          window_stats/   one row per window, from returns and prices only (no model)
12	          path_days/      one row per (window, leverage, day), partitioned by ticker
13	          path_summary/   one row per (window, leverage)
14	          paired/         one row per window, 1x and 2x side by side
15	          checks.json     violation counts of the full-scale checks
16	          run.json        configuration, checksums, Spark settings, timings, counts, status
17	
18	How the work is split (docs/spec.md, sections 6 and 7):
19	  - window members: each definition is exploded into its rows and joined to a
20	    broadcast of the returns (about 39k rows).
21	  - model: groupBy(window key).applyInPandas sorts each window by date, checks it is
22	    complete, and runs model.simulate_path for every leverage on the same returns,
23	    so 1x and 2x always share their input.
24	  - summaries: Spark aggregations written separately from model.summarize_path, so
25	    comparing the two (etf_risk.verify) is a real check.
26	  - pairing: conditional aggregation on the window key, never a join on ticker only.
27	  - null rule: Spark's sum/avg/min/max skip nulls, so every aggregate carries the
28	    count of terms it used and is null unless that count is complete.
29	
30	Exit codes: 0 all checks passed, 1 a check failed, 2 the run failed, 3 checksum error.
31	
32	AI contribution: written with Claude Code (Opus 5.5). Verified with
33	tests/test_spark_equivalence.py (including failure injection) and by the
34	sample comparison in etf_risk.verify on the stride-21 run.
35	"""
36	from __future__ import annotations
37	
38	import argparse
39	import json
40	import os
41	import platform
42	import subprocess
43	import sys
44	import time
45	import traceback
46	from collections.abc import Sequence
47	from datetime import datetime, timezone
48	from importlib.metadata import version as package_version
49	from pathlib import Path
50	
51	import pandas as pd
52	from pyspark.sql import DataFrame, SparkSession, Window
53	from pyspark.sql import functions as F
54	from pyspark.sql.types import DateType, DoubleType, IntegerType, StringType, StructField, StructType
55	
56	from etf_risk.model import STATUS_BREACH, STATUS_OK, simulate_path
57	from etf_risk.provenance import code_state, resolve
58	from etf_risk.windows import WINDOW_KEY, ChecksumError, verify_checksums
59	
60	LEVERAGES = (1.0, 2.0)            # pairing compares these two
61	PATH_KEY = WINDOW_KEY + ["leverage"]
62	INITIAL_NAV = 100.0
63	RTOL, ATOL = 1e-9, 1e-12          # 1x identity and turnover identity
64	GAP_ATOL = 1e-9                   # exact log-gap identity
65	BOUND_TOL = 1e-12                 # drawdown bound
66	
67	PATH_DAY_SCHEMA = StructType([
68	    StructField("window_kind", StringType(), False),
69	    StructField("ticker", StringType(), False),
70	    StructField("window_days", IntegerType(), False),
71	    StructField("entry_date", DateType(), False),
72	    StructField("leverage", DoubleType(), False),
73	    StructField("day", IntegerType(), False),
74	    StructField("date", DateType(), False),
75	    StructField("daily_return", DoubleType(), False),
76	    StructField("nav_start", DoubleType(), True),
77	    StructField("nav", DoubleType(), True),
78	    StructField("exposure_before", DoubleType(), True),
79	    StructField("exposure_target", DoubleType(), True),
80	    StructField("rebalance", DoubleType(), True),
81	    StructField("running_peak", DoubleType(), True),
82	    StructField("drawdown", DoubleType(), True),
83	    StructField("status", StringType(), False),
84	])
85	
86	PAIR_SQL = """
87	SELECT window_kind, ticker, window_days, entry_date,
88	       COUNT(*)                                                AS n_paths,
89	       COUNT(DISTINCT leverage)                                AS n_leverages,
90	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 1.0 THEN total_return END)     AS return_1x,
91	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN total_return END)     AS return_2x,
92	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 1.0 THEN max_drawdown END)     AS mdd_1x,
93	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN max_drawdown END)     AS _mdd_2x,
94	       BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN leverage = 1.0 THEN breached END)     AS breached_1x,
95	       BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN breached END)     AS breached_2x,
96	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN breach_date END)      AS breach_date_2x,
97	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN breach_day END)       AS breach_day_2x,
98	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN last_ok_date END)     AS last_ok_date_2x,
99	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN days_ok END)          AS days_ok_2x,
100	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN mean_turnover END)    AS _mean_turnover_2x,
101	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN max_turnover END)     AS _max_turnover_2x,
102	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN total_turnover END)   AS _total_turnover_2x,
103	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN n_turnover_days END)  AS n_turnover_days_2x
104	FROM path_summary
105	GROUP BY window_kind, ticker, window_days, entry_date
106	"""
107	
108	
109	def build_spark(master: str = "local[*]", shuffle_partitions: int | None = None) -> SparkSession:
110	    # Without this, Spark binds to the Wi-Fi interface on macOS.
111	    os.environ.setdefault("SPARK_LOCAL_IP", "127.0.0.1")
112	    builder = (
113	        SparkSession.builder.master(master)
114	        .appName("etf-risk")
115	        .config("spark.ui.enabled", "false")
116	        .config("spark.sql.session.timeZone", "UTC")
117	    )
118	    if shuffle_partitions is not None:
119	        builder = builder.config("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", str(shuffle_partitions))
120	    spark = builder.getOrCreate()
121	    spark.sparkContext.setLogLevel("ERROR")
122	    return spark
123	
124	
125	# --- building blocks -------------------------------------------------------------
126	
127	def returns_with_rows(returns: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
128	    """Add `row` per ticker (0 = first price), the index used by the window definitions."""
129	    return returns.withColumn("row", (F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("ticker").orderBy("date")) - 1).cast("int"))
130	
131	
132	def window_members(defs: DataFrame, returns: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
133	    rows = defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY, F.explode(F.sequence(F.col("entry_row") + 1, F.col("entry_row") + F.col("window_days"))).alias("row"))
134	    return rows.join(F.broadcast(returns.select("ticker", "row", "date", "daily_return")), ["ticker", "row"], "inner")
135	
136	
137	def window_stats(members: DataFrame, defs: DataFrame, returns: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
138	    """Per window, from returns and prices only. Count-guarded: null unless every term was valid."""
139	    r = F.col("daily_return")
140	    valid_r = r.isNotNull() & ~F.isnan(r)
141	    gap_term_ok = valid_r & (1 + 2 * r > 0)         # then (r/(1+r))^2 < 1, so the log is defined
142	    agg = members.groupBy(*WINDOW_KEY).agg(
143	        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("n_member_rows"),
144	        F.countDistinct("date").alias("n_member_dates"),
145	        F.min("date").alias("min_date"),
146	        F.max("date").alias("max_date"),
147	        F.sum(valid_r.cast("int")).alias("n_valid_returns"),
148	        F.sum(F.when(valid_r, r * r)).alias("_sum_sq"),
149	        F.sum(F.when(valid_r, F.abs(r))).alias("_sum_abs"),
150	        F.max(F.when(valid_r, F.abs(r))).alias("_max_abs"),
151	        F.sum(gap_term_ok.cast("int")).alias("n_gap_terms_valid"),
152	        F.sum(F.when(gap_term_ok, F.log1p(-F.pow(r / (1 + r), 2)))).alias("_exact_gap"),
153	    )
154	    complete = F.col("n_valid_returns") == F.col("window_days")
155	    agg = agg.select(
156	        *WINDOW_KEY, "n_member_rows", "n_member_dates", "min_date", "max_date", "n_valid_returns", "n_gap_terms_valid",
157	        F.when(complete, F.col("_sum_sq")).alias("realized_variance"),
158	        F.when(complete, F.col("_sum_abs")).alias("sum_abs_return"),
159	        F.when(complete, F.col("_max_abs")).alias("max_abs_return"),
160	        F.when(F.col("n_gap_terms_valid") == F.col("window_days"), F.col("_exact_gap")).alias("exact_gap"),
161	    )
162	    prices = returns.select("ticker", "row", "date", "adjusted_price")
163	    entry = prices.select("ticker", F.col("row").alias("entry_row"), F.col("date").alias("entry_price_date"),
164	                          F.col("adjusted_price").alias("entry_price"))
165	    exit_ = prices.select("ticker", F.col("row").alias("exit_row"), F.col("date").alias("exit_price_date"),
166	                          F.col("adjusted_price").alias("exit_price"))
167	    d = (defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY, "entry_row", "first_return_date", "exit_date", "contains_unverified_day",
168	                     "unverified_day_count", "entry_on_unverified_day")
169	         .withColumn("exit_row", F.col("entry_row") + F.col("window_days")))
170	    d = d.join(F.broadcast(entry), ["ticker", "entry_row"], "left").join(F.broadcast(exit_), ["ticker", "exit_row"], "left")
171	    return d.join(agg, WINDOW_KEY, "left").withColumn("price_return", F.col("exit_price") / F.col("entry_price") - 1.0)
172	
173	
174	def simulate_windows(members: DataFrame, leverages: Sequence[float] = LEVERAGES, initial_nav: float = INITIAL_NAV) -> DataFrame:
175	    names = PATH_DAY_SCHEMA.fieldNames()
176	    levs = [float(x) for x in leverages]
177	
178	    def run(pdf: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
179	        pdf = pdf.sort_values("date", kind="mergesort")
180	        key = {k: pdf[k].iloc[0] for k in WINDOW_KEY}
181	        if len(pdf) != int(key["window_days"]) or pdf["date"].duplicated().any():
182	            raise ValueError(f"incomplete window {key}: {len(pdf)} rows for {key['window_days']} days")
183	        dates, returns = pdf["date"].to_numpy(), pdf["daily_return"].to_numpy()
184	        out = []
185	        for lev in levs:
186	            path = simulate_path(returns, lev, initial_nav)
187	            for k, v in key.items():
188	                path[k] = v
189	            path["leverage"] = lev
190	            path["date"] = dates[path["day"].to_numpy() - 1]
191	            out.append(path)
192	        return pd.concat(out, ignore_index=True)[names]
193	
194	    return members.groupBy(*WINDOW_KEY).applyInPandas(run, schema=PATH_DAY_SCHEMA)
195	
196	
197	def _valid(cond, col):
198	    """The value where `cond` holds and it is a real number (not null, not NaN)."""
199	    return F.when(cond & col.isNotNull() & ~F.isnan(col), col)
200	
201	
202	def summarize_paths(path_days: DataFrame, defs: DataFrame, initial_nav: float = INITIAL_NAV) -> DataFrame:
203	    ok, breach = F.col("status") == STATUS_OK, F.col("status") == STATUS_BREACH
204	    turnover = F.abs(F.col("rebalance")) / F.col("nav_start")       # fraction of that day's starting NAV
205	    g = path_days.groupBy(*PATH_KEY).agg(
206	        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("n_rows"),
207	        F.countDistinct("day").alias("n_distinct_days"),
208	        F.max("day").alias("max_day"),
209	        F.sum(ok.cast("int")).alias("days_ok"),
210	        F.bool_or(breach).alias("breached"),
211	        F.sum(breach.cast("int")).alias("n_breach_rows"),
212	        F.min(F.when(breach, F.col("day"))).alias("breach_day"),
213	        F.min(F.when(breach, F.col("date"))).alias("breach_date"),
214	        F.max(F.when(ok, F.col("date"))).alias("last_ok_date"),
215	        F.max_by(_valid(ok, F.col("nav")), F.when(ok, F.col("day"))).alias("_last_ok_nav"),
216	        F.count(_valid(ok, F.col("nav"))).alias("n_valid_nav"),
217	        F.max(_valid(ok, F.col("drawdown"))).alias("_max_drawdown"),
218	        F.count(_valid(ok, F.col("drawdown"))).alias("n_valid_drawdown"),
219	        F.avg(_valid(ok, turnover)).alias("_mean_turnover"),
220	        F.max(_valid(ok, turnover)).alias("_max_turnover"),
221	        F.sum(_valid(ok, turnover)).alias("_total_turnover"),
222	        # ties: the earliest date with the maximum turnover
223	        F.max_by(F.col("date"), F.struct(_valid(ok, turnover), -F.unix_date(F.col("date")))).alias("_max_turnover_date"),
224	        F.count(_valid(ok, turnover)).alias("n_turnover_days"),
225	        F.sum(_valid(ok, F.abs(F.col("rebalance")))).alias("_total_abs_rebalance"),
226	        F.max(_valid(ok, F.abs(F.col("rebalance")))).alias("_max_abs_rebalance"),
227	        F.count(_valid(ok, F.abs(F.col("rebalance")))).alias("n_valid_rebalance"),
228	    )
229	    s = g.select(
230	        *PATH_KEY, "n_rows", "n_distinct_days", "max_day", "days_ok", "breached", "n_breach_rows",
231	        "breach_day", "breach_date", "last_ok_date", "n_valid_nav", "n_valid_drawdown", "n_turnover_days",
232	        "n_valid_rebalance",
233	        F.when(_final_nav_complete(), F.col("_last_ok_nav")).alias("final_nav"),
234	        # the starting NAV is a peak candidate, so a path with no ok day has drawdown 0 (as summarize_path)
235	        F.when(_drawdown_complete(), F.coalesce(F.col("_max_drawdown"), F.lit(0.0))).alias("max_drawdown"),
236	        F.when(_turnover_complete(), F.col("_mean_turnover")).alias("mean_turnover"),
237	        F.when(_turnover_complete(), F.col("_max_turnover")).alias("max_turnover"),
238	        F.when(_turnover_complete(), F.col("_total_turnover")).alias("total_turnover"),
239	        F.when(_turnover_complete() & (F.col("_max_turnover") > 0), F.col("_max_turnover_date")).alias("max_turnover_date"),
240	        F.when(_rebalance_complete(), F.coalesce(F.col("_total_abs_rebalance"), F.lit(0.0))).alias("total_abs_rebalance"),
241	        F.when(_rebalance_complete(), F.coalesce(F.col("_max_abs_rebalance"), F.lit(0.0))).alias("max_abs_rebalance"),
242	    ).withColumn("total_return", F.col("final_nav") / F.lit(initial_nav) - 1.0)
243	    scheduled = defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY, "first_return_date", "exit_date", "stride", "calendar_year",
244	                            "contains_unverified_day", "unverified_day_count", "entry_on_unverified_day")
245	    return s.join(scheduled, WINDOW_KEY, "left")
246	
247	
248	# Completeness rules for count-guarded path values; summarize_paths applies them and check 10 tests them.
249	def _final_nav_complete():
250	    return ~F.col("breached") & (F.col("n_valid_nav") == F.col("days_ok")) & (F.col("days_ok") == F.col("window_days"))
251	
252	
253	def _drawdown_complete():
254	    return F.col("n_valid_drawdown") == F.col("days_ok")
255	
256	
257	def _turnover_complete():
258	    return (F.col("n_turnover_days") == F.col("days_ok")) & (F.col("days_ok") > 0)
259	
260	
261	def _rebalance_complete():
262	    return F.col("n_valid_rebalance") == F.col("days_ok")
263	
264	
265	PAIRED_2X_PATH_VALUES = ["mdd_2x", "mean_turnover_2x", "max_turnover_2x", "total_turnover_2x"]
266	
267	
268	def pair_paths(summary: DataFrame, stats: DataFrame, leverages: Sequence[float] = LEVERAGES) -> DataFrame:
269	    """One row per window, 1x and 2x side by side. For a breached 2x path the drawdown and turnover cover only
270	    the days before the breach: they go to *_pre_breach columns and the full-window columns are null."""
271	    if tuple(float(x) for x in leverages) != (1.0, 2.0):
272	        raise ValueError(f"pairing compares 1x with 2x; got leverages {tuple(leverages)}")
273	    spark = summary.sparkSession
274	    summary.createOrReplaceTempView("path_summary")
275	    paired = spark.sql(PAIR_SQL)
276	    s = stats.select(*WINDOW_KEY, "first_return_date", "exit_date", "contains_unverified_day", "unverified_day_count",
277	                     "entry_on_unverified_day", "realized_variance", "sum_abs_return", "max_abs_return", "price_return",
278	                     F.col("exact_gap").alias("_exact_gap"))
279	    p = paired.join(s, WINDOW_KEY, "left")
280	    breached, not_breached = F.col("breached_2x"), ~F.col("breached_2x")
281	    for name in PAIRED_2X_PATH_VALUES:
282	        p = p.withColumn(name, F.when(not_breached, F.col(f"_{name}"))) \
283	             .withColumn(f"{name}_pre_breach", F.when(breached, F.col(f"_{name}"))).drop(f"_{name}")
284	    return (
285	        p.withColumn("exact_gap", F.when(not_breached, F.col("_exact_gap"))).drop("_exact_gap")
286	        .withColumn("log_gap", F.when(not_breached & F.col("return_1x").isNotNull() & F.col("return_2x").isNotNull(),
287	                                      F.log1p("return_2x") - 2 * F.log1p("return_1x")))
288	        .withColumn("approx_gap", -F.col("realized_variance"))
289	        .withColumn("approx_rel_error", F.when(F.col("exact_gap").isNotNull() & F.col("realized_variance").isNotNull()
290	                                               & (F.abs("exact_gap") > 0),
291	                                               (F.col("approx_gap") - F.col("exact_gap")) / F.abs("exact_gap")))
292	        .withColumn("mdd_bound", F.when(not_breached & F.col("mdd_1x").isNotNull(), 1 - F.pow(1 - F.col("mdd_1x"), 2)))
293	    )
294	
295	
296	# --- checks ----------------------------------------------------------------------
297	
298	def _violations(df: DataFrame, checks: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, int]:
299	    """Count rows matching each violation condition, in one Spark job."""
300	    row = df.agg(*[F.sum(F.when(cond, 1).otherwise(0)).alias(name) for name, cond in checks.items()]).first()
301	    return {name: int(row[name] or 0) for name in checks}
302	
303	
304	def construction_checks(stats: DataFrame) -> dict[str, int]:
305	    wd = F.col("window_days")
306	    return _violations(stats, {
307	        "member_rows_not_window_days": F.col("n_member_rows").isNull() | (F.col("n_member_rows") != wd)
308	                                       | (F.col("n_member_dates") != wd),
309	        "first_or_last_date_mismatch": ~F.col("min_date").eqNullSafe(F.col("first_return_date"))
310	                                       | ~F.col("max_date").eqNullSafe(F.col("exit_date")),
311	        "entry_or_exit_price_date_mismatch": ~F.col("entry_price_date").eqNullSafe(F.col("entry_date"))
312	                                             | ~F.col("exit_price_date").eqNullSafe(F.col("exit_date")),
313	        "missing_entry_or_exit_price": F.col("entry_price").isNull() | F.col("exit_price").isNull(),
314	    })
315	
316	
317	def run_checks(stats: DataFrame, path_days: DataFrame, summary: DataFrame, paired: DataFrame, defs: DataFrame,
318	               leverages: Sequence[float] = LEVERAGES) -> dict[str, dict]:
319	    n_lev = len(leverages)
320	    breached = F.col("breached")
321	    results = {"window_construction": construction_checks(stats)}
322	    results["complete_paths"] = _violations(summary, {
323	        "rows_not_window_days_or_breach_day": (~breached & (F.col("n_rows") != F.col("window_days")))
324	                                              | (breached & ~F.col("n_rows").eqNullSafe(F.col("breach_day"))),
325	        "days_not_numbered_1_to_rows": (F.col("max_day") != F.col("n_rows")) | (F.col("n_distinct_days") != F.col("n_rows")),
326	        "days_ok_inconsistent": F.col("days_ok") != F.col("n_rows") - F.when(breached, 1).otherwise(0),
327	        "more_than_one_breach_row": F.col("n_breach_rows") > 1,
328	    })
329	    missing = defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY).join(paired.select(*WINDOW_KEY), WINDOW_KEY, "left_anti").count()
330	    extra = paired.select(*WINDOW_KEY).join(defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY), WINDOW_KEY, "left_anti").count()
331	    results["pairing"] = {
332	        **_violations(paired, {"not_one_row_per_leverage": (F.col("n_paths") != n_lev) | (F.col("n_leverages") != n_lev)}),
333	        "definitions_without_paired_row": missing,
334	        "paired_rows_without_definition": extra,
335	    }
336	    not_breached_2x = ~F.col("breached_2x")
337	    results["one_x_identity"] = _violations(paired, {
338	        "return_1x_differs_from_price_return": F.col("return_1x").isNull() | F.col("price_return").isNull()
339	        | (F.abs(F.col("return_1x") - F.col("price_return")) > ATOL + RTOL * F.abs(F.col("price_return"))),
340	    })
341	    results["exact_log_gap"] = _violations(paired, {
342	        "log_gap_differs_from_exact_gap": not_breached_2x & (F.col("log_gap").isNull() | F.col("exact_gap").isNull()
343	                                                             | (F.abs(F.col("log_gap") - F.col("exact_gap")) > GAP_ATOL)),
344	    })
345	    results["drawdown_bound"] = _violations(paired, {
346	        "mdd_2x_below_bound": not_breached_2x & (F.col("mdd_2x").isNull() | F.col("mdd_bound").isNull()
347	                                                 | (F.col("mdd_2x") < F.col("mdd_bound") - BOUND_TOL)),
348	    })
349	    nav, ok = F.col("nav"), F.col("status") == STATUS_OK
350	    expected_turnover = F.col("leverage") * (F.col("leverage") - 1) * F.abs(F.col("daily_return"))
351	    turnover = F.abs(F.col("rebalance")) / F.col("nav_start")
352	    results["nav_sanity"] = _violations(path_days, {
353	        "negative_nav": nav < 0,
354	        "nan_nav_outside_breach_rows": F.isnan(nav) & (F.col("status") != STATUS_BREACH),
355	        "ok_row_without_valid_nav": ok & (nav.isNull() | F.isnan(nav)),
356	    })
357	    results["turnover_identity"] = _violations(path_days, {
358	        "turnover_differs_from_L(L-1)|r|": ok & (turnover.isNull() | F.isnan(turnover)
359	                                               | (F.abs(turnover - expected_turnover) > ATOL + RTOL * expected_turnover)),
360	        "nonzero_turnover_at_1x": ok & (F.col("leverage") == 1.0) & (F.abs(F.col("rebalance")) != 0),
361	    })
362	    results["breach_flagged_unverified"] = _violations(paired, {
363	        "breached_window_not_flagged": F.col("breached_2x") & ~F.col("contains_unverified_day"),
364	    })
365	    results["null_rule"] = null_rule_checks(stats, summary, paired)
366	    return results
367	
368	
369	def _null_iff(column: str, should_be_null) -> object:
370	    """Violation: the column is null when it should be set, or set when it should be null (both directions)."""
371	    return F.col(column).isNull() != F.coalesce(should_be_null, F.lit(True))
372	
373	
374	def null_rule_checks(stats: DataFrame, summary: DataFrame, paired: DataFrame) -> dict[str, int]:
375	    """Check 10: every count-guarded value is null exactly when its count of valid terms is short."""
376	    returns_short = F.col("n_valid_returns") != F.col("window_days")
377	    gap_short = F.col("n_gap_terms_valid") != F.col("window_days")
378	    breached = F.col("breached_2x")
379	    return {
380	        **_violations(stats, {
381	            "window_stats.realized_variance": _null_iff("realized_variance", returns_short),
382	            "window_stats.sum_abs_return": _null_iff("sum_abs_return", returns_short),
383	            "window_stats.max_abs_return": _null_iff("max_abs_return", returns_short),
384	            "window_stats.exact_gap": _null_iff("exact_gap", gap_short),
385	        }),
386	        **_violations(summary, {
387	            "path_summary.final_nav": _null_iff("final_nav", ~_final_nav_complete()),
388	            "path_summary.total_return": _null_iff("total_return", ~_final_nav_complete()),
389	            "path_summary.max_drawdown": _null_iff("max_drawdown", ~_drawdown_complete()),
390	            "path_summary.mean_turnover": _null_iff("mean_turnover", ~_turnover_complete()),
391	            "path_summary.max_turnover": _null_iff("max_turnover", ~_turnover_complete()),
392	            "path_summary.total_turnover": _null_iff("total_turnover", ~_turnover_complete()),
393	            "path_summary.max_turnover_date": _null_iff("max_turnover_date",
394	                                                        ~(_turnover_complete() & (F.col("max_turnover") > 0))),
395	            "path_summary.total_abs_rebalance": _null_iff("total_abs_rebalance", ~_rebalance_complete()),
396	            "path_summary.max_abs_rebalance": _null_iff("max_abs_rebalance", ~_rebalance_complete()),
397	        }),
398	        **_violations(paired, {
399	            # in a 2x window without a breach every gap term is valid, so these are set exactly when not breached
400	            "paired.exact_gap": _null_iff("exact_gap", breached),
401	            "paired.log_gap": _null_iff("log_gap", breached),
402	            "paired.return_2x": _null_iff("return_2x", breached),
403	            "paired.mdd_bound": _null_iff("mdd_bound", breached),
404	            "paired.approx_rel_error": _null_iff("approx_rel_error", breached | (F.abs(F.col("exact_gap")) == 0)),
405	            "paired.mdd_2x": _null_iff("mdd_2x", breached),
406	            "paired.mdd_2x_pre_breach": _null_iff("mdd_2x_pre_breach", ~breached),
407	            **{f"paired.{name}": _null_iff(name, breached) for name in PAIRED_2X_PATH_VALUES[1:]},
408	            # no pre-breach turnover exists when the breach is on day 1 (no day before it)
409	            **{f"paired.{name}_pre_breach": _null_iff(f"{name}_pre_breach", ~breached | (F.col("days_ok_2x") == 0))
410	               for name in PAIRED_2X_PATH_VALUES[1:]},
411	        }),
412	    }
413	
414	
415	def total_violations(checks: dict[str, dict]) -> int:
416	    return sum(v for group in checks.values() for v in group.values())
417	
418	
419	# --- whole run -------------------------------------------------------------------
420	
421	def compute(spark: SparkSession, defs: DataFrame, returns: DataFrame, leverages: Sequence[float] = LEVERAGES,
422	            initial_nav: float = INITIAL_NAV, out_dir: Path | None = None, timings: dict | None = None) -> dict:
423	    """Run everything. With out_dir, each table is written and read back, so the model runs once."""
424	    timings = {} if timings is None else timings
425	
426	    def materialize(df: DataFrame, name: str, partition_by: str | None = None) -> DataFrame:
427	        if out_dir is None:
428	            return df
429	        writer = df.write.mode("error")
430	        if partition_by:
431	            writer = writer.partitionBy(partition_by)
432	        writer.parquet(str(out_dir / name))
433	        return spark.read.parquet(str(out_dir / name))
434	
435	    def phase(name: str):
436	        spark.sparkContext.setJobGroup(name, name)
437	        return time.perf_counter()
438	
439	    t = phase("window_stats")
440	    returns = returns_with_rows(returns)
441	    members = window_members(defs, returns)
442	    stats = materialize(window_stats(members, defs, returns), "window_stats")
443	    construction = construction_checks(stats)
444	    timings["window_stats_and_construction_check"] = time.perf_counter() - t
445	    if sum(construction.values()):
446	        return {"checks": {"window_construction": construction}, "model_run": False, "stats": stats}
447	
448	    t = phase("model")
449	    path_days = materialize(simulate_windows(members, leverages, initial_nav), "path_days", partition_by="ticker")
450	    timings["model_and_path_days"] = time.perf_counter() - t
451	
452	    t = phase("summaries")
453	    summary = materialize(summarize_paths(path_days, defs, initial_nav), "path_summary")
454	    paired = materialize(pair_paths(summary, stats, leverages), "paired")
455	    timings["summaries_and_pairing"] = time.perf_counter() - t
456	
457	    t = phase("checks")
458	    checks = run_checks(stats, path_days, summary, paired, defs, leverages)
459	    timings["checks"] = time.perf_counter() - t
460	    return {"checks": checks, "model_run": True, "stats": stats, "path_days": path_days, "summary": summary, "paired": paired}
461	
462	
463	def stage_task_counts(spark: SparkSession, groups: Sequence[str]) -> dict:
464	    tracker = spark.sparkContext.statusTracker()
465	    out = {}
466	    for group in groups:
467	        jobs = tracker.getJobIdsForGroup(group)
468	        stages = [s for j in jobs if (info := tracker.getJobInfo(j)) for s in info.stageIds]
469	        tasks = [si.numTasks for s in stages if (si := tracker.getStageInfo(s))]
470	        out[group] = {"jobs": len(jobs), "stages": len(stages), "tasks": sum(tasks)}
471	    return out
472	
473	
474	def spark_settings(spark: SparkSession) -> dict:
475	    """Effective values. spark.conf.get(key) without a default returns Spark's default for unset SQL
476	    settings; passing a default instead would return that default whenever the key was never set."""
477	    sql_keys = ["spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", "spark.sql.adaptive.enabled",
478	                "spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.enabled", "spark.sql.adaptive.advisoryPartitionSizeInBytes",
479	                "spark.sql.autoBroadcastJoinThreshold"]
480	    settings = {k: spark.conf.get(k) for k in sql_keys}
481	    conf = spark.sparkContext.getConf()
482	    settings["spark.master"] = conf.get("spark.master")
483	    settings["spark.driver.memory"] = conf.get("spark.driver.memory", "not set (Spark default 1g)")
484	    settings["default_parallelism"] = spark.sparkContext.defaultParallelism
485	    settings["spark_version"] = spark.version
486	    try:      # the heap the driver JVM actually got, rather than the configured or default value
487	        settings["jvm_max_heap_bytes"] = int(spark.sparkContext._jvm.java.lang.Runtime.getRuntime().maxMemory())
488	    except Exception:
489	        settings["jvm_max_heap_bytes"] = None
490	    return settings
491	
492	
493	def environment() -> dict:
494	    env = {
495	        "platform": platform.platform(), "macos": platform.mac_ver()[0] or None, "machine": platform.machine(),
496	        "cpu_count": os.cpu_count(), "python": platform.python_version(),
497	        "packages": {p: _version(p) for p in ("pyspark", "pandas", "numpy", "pyarrow", "pandas_market_calendars", "psutil")},
498	    }
499	    try:
500	        java = subprocess.run(["java", "-version"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
501	        env["java"] = (java.stderr or java.stdout).splitlines()[0]
502	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, IndexError):
503	        env["java"] = "unknown"
504	    try:
505	        import psutil
506	        env["ram_total_bytes"] = psutil.virtual_memory().total
507	    except ImportError:
508	        env["ram_total_bytes"] = None
509	    return env
510	
511	
512	def _version(package: str) -> str | None:
513	    try:
514	        return package_version(package)
515	    except Exception:
516	        return None
517	
518	
519	def run_dir_for(windows_dir: Path, out_root: Path, run_id: str) -> Path:
520	    config = json.loads((windows_dir / "config.json").read_text())
521	    return out_root / config["snapshot"] / windows_dir.name / run_id
522	
523	
524	def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
525	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
526	    parser.add_argument("--windows", type=Path, required=True, help="window-definition folder from etf_risk.windows")
527	    parser.add_argument("--out-root", type=Path, default=Path("data/outputs/windows"))
528	    parser.add_argument("--run-id", default=None, help="default: run-<UTC time>")
529	    parser.add_argument("--initial-nav", type=float, default=INITIAL_NAV)
530	    parser.add_argument("--master", default="local[*]")
531	    return parser
532	
533	
534	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
535	    started = time.perf_counter()
536	    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
537	    run_id = args.run_id or "run-" + datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
538	    try:
539	        config, verified = verify_checksums(args.windows)
540	    except (ChecksumError, FileNotFoundError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
541	        print(f"checksum verification failed, Spark not started:\n{exc}", file=sys.stderr)
542	        return 3
543	    run_dir = run_dir_for(args.windows, args.out_root, run_id)
544	    if run_dir.exists():
545	        print(f"{run_dir} exists; use a new --run-id", file=sys.stderr)
546	        return 2
547	    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
548	    record = {
549	        "run_id": run_id, "started_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
550	        "code": code_state(), "windows_dir": str(args.windows),
551	        "windows_config": config, "verified_sha256": verified, "leverages": list(LEVERAGES),
552	        "initial_nav": args.initial_nav, "environment": environment(), "status": "running",
553	    }
554	    timings: dict[str, float] = {}
555	    status, code = "failed", 2
556	    spark = None
557	    own_session = SparkSession.getActiveSession() is None      # only stop a session started here
558	    try:
559	        t = time.perf_counter()
560	        spark = build_spark(args.master)
561	        timings["session_start"] = time.perf_counter() - t
562	        record["spark"] = spark_settings(spark)
563	        defs = spark.read.parquet(str(args.windows / config["windows_file"]))
564	        return_files = [str(resolve(config["snapshot_dir"]) / rel) for rel in config["inputs_sha256"] if rel.startswith("daily_returns/")]
565	        returns = spark.read.parquet(*return_files)
566	        results = compute(spark, defs, returns, LEVERAGES, args.initial_nav, out_dir=run_dir, timings=timings)
567	        checks = results["checks"]
568	        (run_dir / "checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(checks, indent=2) + "\n")
569	        record["checks"] = checks
570	        record["model_run"] = results["model_run"]
571	        spark.sparkContext.setJobGroup("bookkeeping", "row counts for run.json")   # not part of any timed phase
572	        record["row_counts"] = {"windows": defs.count(), "window_stats": results["stats"].count()}
573	        if results["model_run"]:
574	            record["row_counts"].update({name: results[name].count() for name in ("path_days", "summary", "paired")})
575	        record["stage_task_counts"] = stage_task_counts(spark, ["window_stats", "model", "summaries", "checks"])
576	        status, code = ("ok", 0) if total_violations(checks) == 0 else ("checks_failed", 1)
577	    except Exception as exc:
578	        record["error"] = "".join(traceback.format_exception_only(type(exc), exc)).strip()[-4000:]
579	    finally:
580	        timings["total_in_process"] = time.perf_counter() - started
581	        record.update({"status": status, "timings_seconds": timings, "finished_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
582	        (run_dir / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, default=str) + "\n")
583	        if spark is not None and own_session:
584	            spark.stop()
585	    print(f"{run_id}: {status}  ({record.get('row_counts', {})})  -> {run_dir}")
586	    for group, violations in record.get("checks", {}).items():
587	        bad = {k: v for k, v in violations.items() if v}
588	        print(f"  {group}: {'ok' if not bad else bad}")
589	    if "error" in record:
590	        print("  error:", record["error"].splitlines()[-1], file=sys.stderr)
591	    return code
592	
593	
594	if __name__ == "__main__":
595	    sys.exit(main())

"""Run the leveraged-return model over window definitions in Spark, then summarize, pair and check.

Usage:
    uv run python -m etf_risk.spark_pipeline --windows data/windows/full-2026-10-12/rolling-252-s21
    (for timed runs, start it through etf_risk.measure, which also records peak memory)

Input:  a window-definition folder from etf_risk.windows (windows.parquet + config.json) and
        the return files of the snapshot named in its config. Every SHA-256 recorded in the
        config is verified before Spark starts; a mismatch stops the run.
Output: data/outputs/windows/<snapshot>/<definitions name>/<run id>/
          window_stats/   one row per window, from returns and prices only (no model)
          path_days/      one row per (window, leverage, day), partitioned by ticker
          path_summary/   one row per (window, leverage)
          paired/         one row per window, 1x and 2x side by side
          checks.json     violation counts of the full-scale checks
          run.json        configuration, checksums, Spark settings, timings, counts, status

How the work is split (docs/spec.md, sections 6 and 7):
  - window members: each definition is exploded into its rows and joined to a
    broadcast of the returns (about 39k rows).
  - model: groupBy(window key).applyInPandas sorts each window by date, checks it is
    complete, and runs model.simulate_path for every leverage on the same returns,
    so 1x and 2x always share their input.
  - summaries: Spark aggregations written separately from model.summarize_path, so
    comparing the two (etf_risk.verify) is a real check.
  - pairing: conditional aggregation on the window key, never a join on ticker only.
  - null rule: Spark's sum/avg/min/max skip nulls, so every aggregate carries the
    count of terms it used and is null unless that count is complete.

Exit codes: 0 all checks passed, 1 a check failed, 2 the run failed, 3 checksum error.

AI contribution: written with Claude Code (Opus 5.5). Verified with
tests/test_spark_equivalence.py (including failure injection) and by the
sample comparison in etf_risk.verify on the stride-21 run.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback
from collections.abc import Sequence
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from importlib.metadata import version as package_version
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from pyspark.sql import DataFrame, SparkSession, Window
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import DateType, DoubleType, IntegerType, StringType, StructField, StructType

from etf_risk.model import STATUS_BREACH, STATUS_OK, simulate_path
from etf_risk.provenance import code_state, resolve
from etf_risk.windows import WINDOW_KEY, ChecksumError, verify_checksums

LEVERAGES = (1.0, 2.0)            # pairing compares these two
PATH_KEY = WINDOW_KEY + ["leverage"]
INITIAL_NAV = 100.0
RTOL, ATOL = 1e-9, 1e-12          # 1x identity and turnover identity
GAP_ATOL = 1e-9                   # exact log-gap identity
BOUND_TOL = 1e-12                 # drawdown bound

PATH_DAY_SCHEMA = StructType([
    StructField("window_kind", StringType(), False),
    StructField("ticker", StringType(), False),
    StructField("window_days", IntegerType(), False),
    StructField("entry_date", DateType(), False),
    StructField("leverage", DoubleType(), False),
    StructField("day", IntegerType(), False),
    StructField("date", DateType(), False),
    StructField("daily_return", DoubleType(), False),
    StructField("nav_start", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("nav", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("exposure_before", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("exposure_target", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("rebalance", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("running_peak", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("drawdown", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("status", StringType(), False),
])

PAIR_SQL = """
SELECT window_kind, ticker, window_days, entry_date,
       COUNT(*)                                                AS n_paths,
       COUNT(DISTINCT leverage)                                AS n_leverages,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 1.0 THEN total_return END)     AS return_1x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN total_return END)     AS return_2x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 1.0 THEN max_drawdown END)     AS mdd_1x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN max_drawdown END)     AS _mdd_2x,
       BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN leverage = 1.0 THEN breached END)     AS breached_1x,
       BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN breached END)     AS breached_2x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN breach_date END)      AS breach_date_2x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN breach_day END)       AS breach_day_2x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN last_ok_date END)     AS last_ok_date_2x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN days_ok END)          AS days_ok_2x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN mean_turnover END)    AS _mean_turnover_2x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN max_turnover END)     AS _max_turnover_2x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN total_turnover END)   AS _total_turnover_2x,
       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN n_turnover_days END)  AS n_turnover_days_2x
FROM path_summary
GROUP BY window_kind, ticker, window_days, entry_date
"""


def build_spark(master: str = "local[*]", shuffle_partitions: int | None = None) -> SparkSession:
    # Without this, Spark binds to the Wi-Fi interface on macOS.
    os.environ.setdefault("SPARK_LOCAL_IP", "127.0.0.1")
    builder = (
        SparkSession.builder.master(master)
        .appName("etf-risk")
        .config("spark.ui.enabled", "false")
        .config("spark.sql.session.timeZone", "UTC")
    )
    if shuffle_partitions is not None:
        builder = builder.config("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", str(shuffle_partitions))
    spark = builder.getOrCreate()
    spark.sparkContext.setLogLevel("ERROR")
    return spark


# --- building blocks -------------------------------------------------------------

def returns_with_rows(returns: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    """Add `row` per ticker (0 = first price), the index used by the window definitions."""
    return returns.withColumn("row", (F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("ticker").orderBy("date")) - 1).cast("int"))


def window_members(defs: DataFrame, returns: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    rows = defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY, F.explode(F.sequence(F.col("entry_row") + 1, F.col("entry_row") + F.col("window_days"))).alias("row"))
    return rows.join(F.broadcast(returns.select("ticker", "row", "date", "daily_return")), ["ticker", "row"], "inner")


def window_stats(members: DataFrame, defs: DataFrame, returns: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    """Per window, from returns and prices only. Count-guarded: null unless every term was valid."""
    r = F.col("daily_return")
    valid_r = r.isNotNull() & ~F.isnan(r)
    gap_term_ok = valid_r & (1 + 2 * r > 0)         # then (r/(1+r))^2 < 1, so the log is defined
    agg = members.groupBy(*WINDOW_KEY).agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("n_member_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("date").alias("n_member_dates"),
        F.min("date").alias("min_date"),
        F.max("date").alias("max_date"),
        F.sum(valid_r.cast("int")).alias("n_valid_returns"),
        F.sum(F.when(valid_r, r * r)).alias("_sum_sq"),
        F.sum(F.when(valid_r, F.abs(r))).alias("_sum_abs"),
        F.max(F.when(valid_r, F.abs(r))).alias("_max_abs"),
        F.sum(gap_term_ok.cast("int")).alias("n_gap_terms_valid"),
        F.sum(F.when(gap_term_ok, F.log1p(-F.pow(r / (1 + r), 2)))).alias("_exact_gap"),
    )
    complete = F.col("n_valid_returns") == F.col("window_days")
    agg = agg.select(
        *WINDOW_KEY, "n_member_rows", "n_member_dates", "min_date", "max_date", "n_valid_returns", "n_gap_terms_valid",
        F.when(complete, F.col("_sum_sq")).alias("realized_variance"),
        F.when(complete, F.col("_sum_abs")).alias("sum_abs_return"),
        F.when(complete, F.col("_max_abs")).alias("max_abs_return"),
        F.when(F.col("n_gap_terms_valid") == F.col("window_days"), F.col("_exact_gap")).alias("exact_gap"),
    )
    prices = returns.select("ticker", "row", "date", "adjusted_price")
    entry = prices.select("ticker", F.col("row").alias("entry_row"), F.col("date").alias("entry_price_date"),
                          F.col("adjusted_price").alias("entry_price"))
    exit_ = prices.select("ticker", F.col("row").alias("exit_row"), F.col("date").alias("exit_price_date"),
                          F.col("adjusted_price").alias("exit_price"))
    d = (defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY, "entry_row", "first_return_date", "exit_date", "contains_unverified_day",
                     "unverified_day_count", "entry_on_unverified_day")
         .withColumn("exit_row", F.col("entry_row") + F.col("window_days")))
    d = d.join(F.broadcast(entry), ["ticker", "entry_row"], "left").join(F.broadcast(exit_), ["ticker", "exit_row"], "left")
    return d.join(agg, WINDOW_KEY, "left").withColumn("price_return", F.col("exit_price") / F.col("entry_price") - 1.0)


def simulate_windows(members: DataFrame, leverages: Sequence[float] = LEVERAGES, initial_nav: float = INITIAL_NAV) -> DataFrame:
    names = PATH_DAY_SCHEMA.fieldNames()
    levs = [float(x) for x in leverages]

    def run(pdf: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        pdf = pdf.sort_values("date", kind="mergesort")
        key = {k: pdf[k].iloc[0] for k in WINDOW_KEY}
        if len(pdf) != int(key["window_days"]) or pdf["date"].duplicated().any():
            raise ValueError(f"incomplete window {key}: {len(pdf)} rows for {key['window_days']} days")
        dates, returns = pdf["date"].to_numpy(), pdf["daily_return"].to_numpy()
        out = []
        for lev in levs:
            path = simulate_path(returns, lev, initial_nav)
            for k, v in key.items():
                path[k] = v
            path["leverage"] = lev
            path["date"] = dates[path["day"].to_numpy() - 1]
            out.append(path)
        return pd.concat(out, ignore_index=True)[names]

    return members.groupBy(*WINDOW_KEY).applyInPandas(run, schema=PATH_DAY_SCHEMA)


def _valid(cond, col):
    """The value where `cond` holds and it is a real number (not null, not NaN)."""
    return F.when(cond & col.isNotNull() & ~F.isnan(col), col)


def summarize_paths(path_days: DataFrame, defs: DataFrame, initial_nav: float = INITIAL_NAV) -> DataFrame:
    ok, breach = F.col("status") == STATUS_OK, F.col("status") == STATUS_BREACH
    turnover = F.abs(F.col("rebalance")) / F.col("nav_start")       # fraction of that day's starting NAV
    g = path_days.groupBy(*PATH_KEY).agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("n_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("day").alias("n_distinct_days"),
        F.max("day").alias("max_day"),
        F.sum(ok.cast("int")).alias("days_ok"),
        F.bool_or(breach).alias("breached"),
        F.sum(breach.cast("int")).alias("n_breach_rows"),
        F.min(F.when(breach, F.col("day"))).alias("breach_day"),
        F.min(F.when(breach, F.col("date"))).alias("breach_date"),
        F.max(F.when(ok, F.col("date"))).alias("last_ok_date"),
        F.max_by(_valid(ok, F.col("nav")), F.when(ok, F.col("day"))).alias("_last_ok_nav"),
        F.count(_valid(ok, F.col("nav"))).alias("n_valid_nav"),
        F.max(_valid(ok, F.col("drawdown"))).alias("_max_drawdown"),
        F.count(_valid(ok, F.col("drawdown"))).alias("n_valid_drawdown"),
        F.avg(_valid(ok, turnover)).alias("_mean_turnover"),
        F.max(_valid(ok, turnover)).alias("_max_turnover"),
        F.sum(_valid(ok, turnover)).alias("_total_turnover"),
        # ties: the earliest date with the maximum turnover
        F.max_by(F.col("date"), F.struct(_valid(ok, turnover), -F.unix_date(F.col("date")))).alias("_max_turnover_date"),
        F.count(_valid(ok, turnover)).alias("n_turnover_days"),
        F.sum(_valid(ok, F.abs(F.col("rebalance")))).alias("_total_abs_rebalance"),
        F.max(_valid(ok, F.abs(F.col("rebalance")))).alias("_max_abs_rebalance"),
        F.count(_valid(ok, F.abs(F.col("rebalance")))).alias("n_valid_rebalance"),
    )
    s = g.select(
        *PATH_KEY, "n_rows", "n_distinct_days", "max_day", "days_ok", "breached", "n_breach_rows",
        "breach_day", "breach_date", "last_ok_date", "n_valid_nav", "n_valid_drawdown", "n_turnover_days",
        "n_valid_rebalance",
        F.when(_final_nav_complete(), F.col("_last_ok_nav")).alias("final_nav"),
        # the starting NAV is a peak candidate, so a path with no ok day has drawdown 0 (as summarize_path)
        F.when(_drawdown_complete(), F.coalesce(F.col("_max_drawdown"), F.lit(0.0))).alias("max_drawdown"),
        F.when(_turnover_complete(), F.col("_mean_turnover")).alias("mean_turnover"),
        F.when(_turnover_complete(), F.col("_max_turnover")).alias("max_turnover"),
        F.when(_turnover_complete(), F.col("_total_turnover")).alias("total_turnover"),
        F.when(_turnover_complete() & (F.col("_max_turnover") > 0), F.col("_max_turnover_date")).alias("max_turnover_date"),
        F.when(_rebalance_complete(), F.coalesce(F.col("_total_abs_rebalance"), F.lit(0.0))).alias("total_abs_rebalance"),
        F.when(_rebalance_complete(), F.coalesce(F.col("_max_abs_rebalance"), F.lit(0.0))).alias("max_abs_rebalance"),
    ).withColumn("total_return", F.col("final_nav") / F.lit(initial_nav) - 1.0)
    scheduled = defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY, "first_return_date", "exit_date", "stride", "calendar_year",
                            "contains_unverified_day", "unverified_day_count", "entry_on_unverified_day")
    return s.join(scheduled, WINDOW_KEY, "left")


# Completeness rules for count-guarded path values; summarize_paths applies them and check 10 tests them.
def _final_nav_complete():
    return ~F.col("breached") & (F.col("n_valid_nav") == F.col("days_ok")) & (F.col("days_ok") == F.col("window_days"))


def _drawdown_complete():
    return F.col("n_valid_drawdown") == F.col("days_ok")


def _turnover_complete():
    return (F.col("n_turnover_days") == F.col("days_ok")) & (F.col("days_ok") > 0)


def _rebalance_complete():
    return F.col("n_valid_rebalance") == F.col("days_ok")


PAIRED_2X_PATH_VALUES = ["mdd_2x", "mean_turnover_2x", "max_turnover_2x", "total_turnover_2x"]


def pair_paths(summary: DataFrame, stats: DataFrame, leverages: Sequence[float] = LEVERAGES) -> DataFrame:
    """One row per window, 1x and 2x side by side. For a breached 2x path the drawdown and turnover cover only
    the days before the breach: they go to *_pre_breach columns and the full-window columns are null."""
    if tuple(float(x) for x in leverages) != (1.0, 2.0):
        raise ValueError(f"pairing compares 1x with 2x; got leverages {tuple(leverages)}")
    spark = summary.sparkSession
    summary.createOrReplaceTempView("path_summary")
    paired = spark.sql(PAIR_SQL)
    s = stats.select(*WINDOW_KEY, "first_return_date", "exit_date", "contains_unverified_day", "unverified_day_count",
                     "entry_on_unverified_day", "realized_variance", "sum_abs_return", "max_abs_return", "price_return",
                     F.col("exact_gap").alias("_exact_gap"))
    p = paired.join(s, WINDOW_KEY, "left")
    breached, not_breached = F.col("breached_2x"), ~F.col("breached_2x")
    for name in PAIRED_2X_PATH_VALUES:
        p = p.withColumn(name, F.when(not_breached, F.col(f"_{name}"))) \
             .withColumn(f"{name}_pre_breach", F.when(breached, F.col(f"_{name}"))).drop(f"_{name}")
    return (
        p.withColumn("exact_gap", F.when(not_breached, F.col("_exact_gap"))).drop("_exact_gap")
        .withColumn("log_gap", F.when(not_breached & F.col("return_1x").isNotNull() & F.col("return_2x").isNotNull(),
                                      F.log1p("return_2x") - 2 * F.log1p("return_1x")))
        .withColumn("approx_gap", -F.col("realized_variance"))
        .withColumn("approx_rel_error", F.when(F.col("exact_gap").isNotNull() & F.col("realized_variance").isNotNull()
                                               & (F.abs("exact_gap") > 0),
                                               (F.col("approx_gap") - F.col("exact_gap")) / F.abs("exact_gap")))
        .withColumn("mdd_bound", F.when(not_breached & F.col("mdd_1x").isNotNull(), 1 - F.pow(1 - F.col("mdd_1x"), 2)))
    )


# --- checks ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def _violations(df: DataFrame, checks: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Count rows matching each violation condition, in one Spark job."""
    row = df.agg(*[F.sum(F.when(cond, 1).otherwise(0)).alias(name) for name, cond in checks.items()]).first()
    return {name: int(row[name] or 0) for name in checks}


def construction_checks(stats: DataFrame) -> dict[str, int]:
    wd = F.col("window_days")
    return _violations(stats, {
        "member_rows_not_window_days": F.col("n_member_rows").isNull() | (F.col("n_member_rows") != wd)
                                       | (F.col("n_member_dates") != wd),
        "first_or_last_date_mismatch": ~F.col("min_date").eqNullSafe(F.col("first_return_date"))
                                       | ~F.col("max_date").eqNullSafe(F.col("exit_date")),
        "entry_or_exit_price_date_mismatch": ~F.col("entry_price_date").eqNullSafe(F.col("entry_date"))
                                             | ~F.col("exit_price_date").eqNullSafe(F.col("exit_date")),
        "missing_entry_or_exit_price": F.col("entry_price").isNull() | F.col("exit_price").isNull(),
    })


def run_checks(stats: DataFrame, path_days: DataFrame, summary: DataFrame, paired: DataFrame, defs: DataFrame,
               leverages: Sequence[float] = LEVERAGES) -> dict[str, dict]:
    n_lev = len(leverages)
    breached = F.col("breached")
    results = {"window_construction": construction_checks(stats)}
    results["complete_paths"] = _violations(summary, {
        "rows_not_window_days_or_breach_day": (~breached & (F.col("n_rows") != F.col("window_days")))
                                              | (breached & ~F.col("n_rows").eqNullSafe(F.col("breach_day"))),
        "days_not_numbered_1_to_rows": (F.col("max_day") != F.col("n_rows")) | (F.col("n_distinct_days") != F.col("n_rows")),
        "days_ok_inconsistent": F.col("days_ok") != F.col("n_rows") - F.when(breached, 1).otherwise(0),
        "more_than_one_breach_row": F.col("n_breach_rows") > 1,
    })
    missing = defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY).join(paired.select(*WINDOW_KEY), WINDOW_KEY, "left_anti").count()
    extra = paired.select(*WINDOW_KEY).join(defs.select(*WINDOW_KEY), WINDOW_KEY, "left_anti").count()
    results["pairing"] = {
        **_violations(paired, {"not_one_row_per_leverage": (F.col("n_paths") != n_lev) | (F.col("n_leverages") != n_lev)}),
        "definitions_without_paired_row": missing,
        "paired_rows_without_definition": extra,
    }
    not_breached_2x = ~F.col("breached_2x")
    results["one_x_identity"] = _violations(paired, {
        "return_1x_differs_from_price_return": F.col("return_1x").isNull() | F.col("price_return").isNull()
        | (F.abs(F.col("return_1x") - F.col("price_return")) > ATOL + RTOL * F.abs(F.col("price_return"))),
    })
    results["exact_log_gap"] = _violations(paired, {
        "log_gap_differs_from_exact_gap": not_breached_2x & (F.col("log_gap").isNull() | F.col("exact_gap").isNull()
                                                             | (F.abs(F.col("log_gap") - F.col("exact_gap")) > GAP_ATOL)),
    })
    results["drawdown_bound"] = _violations(paired, {
        "mdd_2x_below_bound": not_breached_2x & (F.col("mdd_2x").isNull() | F.col("mdd_bound").isNull()
                                                 | (F.col("mdd_2x") < F.col("mdd_bound") - BOUND_TOL)),
    })
    nav, ok = F.col("nav"), F.col("status") == STATUS_OK
    expected_turnover = F.col("leverage") * (F.col("leverage") - 1) * F.abs(F.col("daily_return"))
    turnover = F.abs(F.col("rebalance")) / F.col("nav_start")
    results["nav_sanity"] = _violations(path_days, {
        "negative_nav": nav < 0,
        "nan_nav_outside_breach_rows": F.isnan(nav) & (F.col("status") != STATUS_BREACH),
        "ok_row_without_valid_nav": ok & (nav.isNull() | F.isnan(nav)),
    })
    results["turnover_identity"] = _violations(path_days, {
        "turnover_differs_from_L(L-1)|r|": ok & (turnover.isNull() | F.isnan(turnover)
                                               | (F.abs(turnover - expected_turnover) > ATOL + RTOL * expected_turnover)),
        "nonzero_turnover_at_1x": ok & (F.col("leverage") == 1.0) & (F.abs(F.col("rebalance")) != 0),
    })
    results["breach_flagged_unverified"] = _violations(paired, {
        "breached_window_not_flagged": F.col("breached_2x") & ~F.col("contains_unverified_day"),
    })
    results["null_rule"] = null_rule_checks(stats, summary, paired)
    return results


def _null_iff(column: str, should_be_null) -> object:
    """Violation: the column is null when it should be set, or set when it should be null (both directions)."""
    return F.col(column).isNull() != F.coalesce(should_be_null, F.lit(True))


def null_rule_checks(stats: DataFrame, summary: DataFrame, paired: DataFrame) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Check 10: every count-guarded value is null exactly when its count of valid terms is short."""
    returns_short = F.col("n_valid_returns") != F.col("window_days")
    gap_short = F.col("n_gap_terms_valid") != F.col("window_days")
    breached = F.col("breached_2x")
    return {
        **_violations(stats, {
            "window_stats.realized_variance": _null_iff("realized_variance", returns_short),
            "window_stats.sum_abs_return": _null_iff("sum_abs_return", returns_short),
            "window_stats.max_abs_return": _null_iff("max_abs_return", returns_short),
            "window_stats.exact_gap": _null_iff("exact_gap", gap_short),
        }),
        **_violations(summary, {
            "path_summary.final_nav": _null_iff("final_nav", ~_final_nav_complete()),
            "path_summary.total_return": _null_iff("total_return", ~_final_nav_complete()),
            "path_summary.max_drawdown": _null_iff("max_drawdown", ~_drawdown_complete()),
            "path_summary.mean_turnover": _null_iff("mean_turnover", ~_turnover_complete()),
            "path_summary.max_turnover": _null_iff("max_turnover", ~_turnover_complete()),
            "path_summary.total_turnover": _null_iff("total_turnover", ~_turnover_complete()),
            "path_summary.max_turnover_date": _null_iff("max_turnover_date",
                                                        ~(_turnover_complete() & (F.col("max_turnover") > 0))),
            "path_summary.total_abs_rebalance": _null_iff("total_abs_rebalance", ~_rebalance_complete()),
            "path_summary.max_abs_rebalance": _null_iff("max_abs_rebalance", ~_rebalance_complete()),
        }),
        **_violations(paired, {
            # in a 2x window without a breach every gap term is valid, so these are set exactly when not breached
            "paired.exact_gap": _null_iff("exact_gap", breached),
            "paired.log_gap": _null_iff("log_gap", breached),
            "paired.return_2x": _null_iff("return_2x", breached),
            "paired.mdd_bound": _null_iff("mdd_bound", breached),
            "paired.approx_rel_error": _null_iff("approx_rel_error", breached | (F.abs(F.col("exact_gap")) == 0)),
            "paired.mdd_2x": _null_iff("mdd_2x", breached),
            "paired.mdd_2x_pre_breach": _null_iff("mdd_2x_pre_breach", ~breached),
            **{f"paired.{name}": _null_iff(name, breached) for name in PAIRED_2X_PATH_VALUES[1:]},
            # no pre-breach turnover exists when the breach is on day 1 (no day before it)
            **{f"paired.{name}_pre_breach": _null_iff(f"{name}_pre_breach", ~breached | (F.col("days_ok_2x") == 0))
               for name in PAIRED_2X_PATH_VALUES[1:]},
        }),
    }


def total_violations(checks: dict[str, dict]) -> int:
    return sum(v for group in checks.values() for v in group.values())


# --- whole run -------------------------------------------------------------------

def compute(spark: SparkSession, defs: DataFrame, returns: DataFrame, leverages: Sequence[float] = LEVERAGES,
            initial_nav: float = INITIAL_NAV, out_dir: Path | None = None, timings: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Run everything. With out_dir, each table is written and read back, so the model runs once."""
    timings = {} if timings is None else timings

    def materialize(df: DataFrame, name: str, partition_by: str | None = None) -> DataFrame:
        if out_dir is None:
            return df
        writer = df.write.mode("error")
        if partition_by:
            writer = writer.partitionBy(partition_by)
        writer.parquet(str(out_dir / name))
        return spark.read.parquet(str(out_dir / name))

    def phase(name: str):
        spark.sparkContext.setJobGroup(name, name)
        return time.perf_counter()

    t = phase("window_stats")
    returns = returns_with_rows(returns)
    members = window_members(defs, returns)
    stats = materialize(window_stats(members, defs, returns), "window_stats")
    construction = construction_checks(stats)
    timings["window_stats_and_construction_check"] = time.perf_counter() - t
    if sum(construction.values()):
        return {"checks": {"window_construction": construction}, "model_run": False, "stats": stats}

    t = phase("model")
    path_days = materialize(simulate_windows(members, leverages, initial_nav), "path_days", partition_by="ticker")
    timings["model_and_path_days"] = time.perf_counter() - t

    t = phase("summaries")
    summary = materialize(summarize_paths(path_days, defs, initial_nav), "path_summary")
    paired = materialize(pair_paths(summary, stats, leverages), "paired")
    timings["summaries_and_pairing"] = time.perf_counter() - t

    t = phase("checks")
    checks = run_checks(stats, path_days, summary, paired, defs, leverages)
    timings["checks"] = time.perf_counter() - t
    return {"checks": checks, "model_run": True, "stats": stats, "path_days": path_days, "summary": summary, "paired": paired}


def stage_task_counts(spark: SparkSession, groups: Sequence[str]) -> dict:
    tracker = spark.sparkContext.statusTracker()
    out = {}
    for group in groups:
        jobs = tracker.getJobIdsForGroup(group)
        stages = [s for j in jobs if (info := tracker.getJobInfo(j)) for s in info.stageIds]
        tasks = [si.numTasks for s in stages if (si := tracker.getStageInfo(s))]
        out[group] = {"jobs": len(jobs), "stages": len(stages), "tasks": sum(tasks)}
    return out


def spark_settings(spark: SparkSession) -> dict:
    """Effective values. spark.conf.get(key) without a default returns Spark's default for unset SQL
    settings; passing a default instead would return that default whenever the key was never set."""
    sql_keys = ["spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", "spark.sql.adaptive.enabled",
                "spark.sql.adaptive.coalescePartitions.enabled", "spark.sql.adaptive.advisoryPartitionSizeInBytes",
                "spark.sql.autoBroadcastJoinThreshold"]
    settings = {k: spark.conf.get(k) for k in sql_keys}
    conf = spark.sparkContext.getConf()
    settings["spark.master"] = conf.get("spark.master")
    settings["spark.driver.memory"] = conf.get("spark.driver.memory", "not set (Spark default 1g)")
    settings["default_parallelism"] = spark.sparkContext.defaultParallelism
    settings["spark_version"] = spark.version
    try:      # the heap the driver JVM actually got, rather than the configured or default value
        settings["jvm_max_heap_bytes"] = int(spark.sparkContext._jvm.java.lang.Runtime.getRuntime().maxMemory())
    except Exception:
        settings["jvm_max_heap_bytes"] = None
    return settings


def environment() -> dict:
    env = {
        "platform": platform.platform(), "macos": platform.mac_ver()[0] or None, "machine": platform.machine(),
        "cpu_count": os.cpu_count(), "python": platform.python_version(),
        "packages": {p: _version(p) for p in ("pyspark", "pandas", "numpy", "pyarrow", "pandas_market_calendars", "psutil")},
    }
    try:
        java = subprocess.run(["java", "-version"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        env["java"] = (java.stderr or java.stdout).splitlines()[0]
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, IndexError):
        env["java"] = "unknown"
    try:
        import psutil
        env["ram_total_bytes"] = psutil.virtual_memory().total
    except ImportError:
        env["ram_total_bytes"] = None
    return env


def _version(package: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        return package_version(package)
    except Exception:
        return None


def run_dir_for(windows_dir: Path, out_root: Path, run_id: str) -> Path:
    config = json.loads((windows_dir / "config.json").read_text())
    return out_root / config["snapshot"] / windows_dir.name / run_id


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--windows", type=Path, required=True, help="window-definition folder from etf_risk.windows")
    parser.add_argument("--out-root", type=Path, default=Path("data/outputs/windows"))
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", default=None, help="default: run-<UTC time>")
    parser.add_argument("--initial-nav", type=float, default=INITIAL_NAV)
    parser.add_argument("--master", default="local[*]")
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    run_id = args.run_id or "run-" + datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    try:
        config, verified = verify_checksums(args.windows)
    except (ChecksumError, FileNotFoundError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        print(f"checksum verification failed, Spark not started:\n{exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    run_dir = run_dir_for(args.windows, args.out_root, run_id)
    if run_dir.exists():
        print(f"{run_dir} exists; use a new --run-id", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    record = {
        "run_id": run_id, "started_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "code": code_state(), "windows_dir": str(args.windows),
        "windows_config": config, "verified_sha256": verified, "leverages": list(LEVERAGES),
        "initial_nav": args.initial_nav, "environment": environment(), "status": "running",
    }
    timings: dict[str, float] = {}
    status, code = "failed", 2
    spark = None
    own_session = SparkSession.getActiveSession() is None      # only stop a session started here
    try:
        t = time.perf_counter()
        spark = build_spark(args.master)
        timings["session_start"] = time.perf_counter() - t
        record["spark"] = spark_settings(spark)
        defs = spark.read.parquet(str(args.windows / config["windows_file"]))
        return_files = [str(resolve(config["snapshot_dir"]) / rel) for rel in config["inputs_sha256"] if rel.startswith("daily_returns/")]
        returns = spark.read.parquet(*return_files)
        results = compute(spark, defs, returns, LEVERAGES, args.initial_nav, out_dir=run_dir, timings=timings)
        checks = results["checks"]
        (run_dir / "checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(checks, indent=2) + "\n")
        record["checks"] = checks
        record["model_run"] = results["model_run"]
        spark.sparkContext.setJobGroup("bookkeeping", "row counts for run.json")   # not part of any timed phase
        record["row_counts"] = {"windows": defs.count(), "window_stats": results["stats"].count()}
        if results["model_run"]:
            record["row_counts"].update({name: results[name].count() for name in ("path_days", "summary", "paired")})
        record["stage_task_counts"] = stage_task_counts(spark, ["window_stats", "model", "summaries", "checks"])
        status, code = ("ok", 0) if total_violations(checks) == 0 else ("checks_failed", 1)
    except Exception as exc:
        record["error"] = "".join(traceback.format_exception_only(type(exc), exc)).strip()[-4000:]
    finally:
        timings["total_in_process"] = time.perf_counter() - started
        record.update({"status": status, "timings_seconds": timings, "finished_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
        (run_dir / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, default=str) + "\n")
        if spark is not None and own_session:
            spark.stop()
    print(f"{run_id}: {status}  ({record.get('row_counts', {})})  -> {run_dir}")
    for group, violations in record.get("checks", {}).items():
        bad = {k: v for k, v in violations.items() if v}
        print(f"  {group}: {'ok' if not bad else bad}")
    if "error" in record:
        print("  error:", record["error"].splitlines()[-1], file=sys.stderr)
    return code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import json

    if exit_code not in (0, 1):
        reasons.append(f"failed (exit code {exit_code})")
    if exit_code == 1:
        reasons.append("checks_failed")
    if exceeded:
        reasons.append("memory_threshold_exceeded")
    if exit_code not in (0, 1):
        return "failed", reasons
    if exit_code == 1:
        return "checks_failed", reasons
    return ("memory_threshold_exceeded" if exceeded else "ok"), reasons


def run_protocol(make_command: Callable[[str], Sequence[str]], run_dir_of: Callable[[str], Path], log_dir: Path,
                 repeats: int, interval: float = DEFAULT_INTERVAL,
                 threshold_fraction: float = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_FRACTION) -> dict:
    total_ram = psutil.virtual_memory().total
    threshold = threshold_fraction * total_ram
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    runs, stop_reason = [], None
    for i in range(repeats):
        run_id = f"run-{stamp}-{i + 1}"
        free_before = psutil.virtual_memory().available
        started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        log_path = log_dir / f"{run_id}.log"
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        with log_path.open("w") as log:
            proc = subprocess.Popen(list(make_command(run_id)), stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            sampler = TreeSampler(proc.pid, interval, threshold)
            sampler.start()
            exit_code = proc.wait()
            sampler.stop()
        wall = time.perf_counter() - t0
        status, reasons = run_status(exit_code, sampler.exceeded)
        measurement = {
            "warmup": i == 0, "exit_code": exit_code, "protocol_status": status, "stop_reasons": reasons,
            "wall_seconds": round(wall, 3), "started_at_utc": started_at, "log": str(log_path),
            "free_memory_before_bytes": free_before, "peak_rss_total_bytes": sampler.peak_total,
            "peak_rss_by_kind_bytes": sampler.peak_by_kind, "samples": sampler.samples,
            "sample_interval_seconds": interval, "max_processes_seen": sampler.max_processes,
            "threshold_bytes": int(threshold), "threshold_first_exceeded_after_seconds": sampler.first_exceeded_at,
            "limits": LIMITS,
        }
        run_json = run_dir_of(run_id) / "run.json"
        record = json.loads(run_json.read_text()) if run_json.exists() else {"run_id": run_id, "status": "no run.json written"}
        record["measurement"] = measurement
        if run_json.parent.exists():
            run_json.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, default=str) + "\n")
        runs.append({
            "run_id": run_id, "warmup": i == 0, "status": status, "exit_code": exit_code, "wall_seconds": round(wall, 3),
            "in_process_seconds": record.get("timings_seconds", {}), "peak_rss_total_bytes": sampler.peak_total,
            "peak_rss_by_kind_bytes": sampler.peak_by_kind, "samples": sampler.samples,
        })
        if reasons:
            stop_reason = f"{run_id}: {', '.join(reasons)}"
            break
    measured = [r for r in runs if not r["warmup"] and r["status"] == "ok"]

    def spread(values):
        return {"median": statistics.median(values), "min": min(values), "max": max(values)} if values else None

    return {
        "protocol_started": stamp, "code": code_state(), "repeats_requested": repeats, "runs_started": len(runs),
        "stopped_early": stop_reason is not None, "stop_reason": stop_reason,
        "total_ram_bytes": total_ram, "threshold_fraction": threshold_fraction, "threshold_bytes": int(threshold),
        "sample_interval_seconds": interval, "limits": LIMITS, "runs": runs,
        "summary_over_measured_runs": {
            "runs": [r["run_id"] for r in measured],
            "wall_seconds": spread([r["wall_seconds"] for r in measured]),
            "peak_rss_total_bytes": spread([r["peak_rss_total_bytes"] for r in measured]),
        },
    }


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    argv = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
    if "--" not in argv:
        print("usage: python -m etf_risk.measure [--repeats N] -- <spark_pipeline arguments>", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    split = argv.index("--")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--interval", type=float, default=DEFAULT_INTERVAL)
    parser.add_argument("--threshold-fraction", type=float, default=DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_FRACTION)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv[:split])
    pipeline_args = argv[split + 1:]

    from etf_risk import spark_pipeline                      # imports pyspark only after argument checks
    pargs = spark_pipeline.build_parser().parse_args(pipeline_args)
    base = spark_pipeline.run_dir_for(pargs.windows, pargs.out_root, "x").parent

    result = run_protocol(
        make_command=lambda run_id: [sys.executable, "-m", "etf_risk.spark_pipeline", *pipeline_args, "--run-id", run_id],
        run_dir_of=lambda run_id: base / run_id, log_dir=base, repeats=args.repeats,
        interval=args.interval, threshold_fraction=args.threshold_fraction,
    )
    path = base / f"protocol-{result['protocol_started']}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, default=str) + "\n")
    gib = 1024 ** 3
    print(f"threshold {result['threshold_bytes'] / gib:.2f} GiB ({args.threshold_fraction:.0%} of "
          f"{result['total_ram_bytes'] / gib:.1f} GiB); runs started {result['runs_started']} of {args.repeats}")
    for r in result["runs"]:
        print(f"  {r['run_id']}{' (warm-up)' if r['warmup'] else ''}: {r['status']}, {r['wall_seconds']:.1f} s, "
              f"peak RSS {r['peak_rss_total_bytes'] / gib:.2f} GiB, {r['samples']} samples")
    if result["stopped_early"]:
        print("  stopped:", result["stop_reason"])
    print(f"protocol: {path}")
    return 0 if not result["stopped_early"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

1	"""Run the leveraged-return model over window definitions in Spark, then summarize, pair and check.
2	
3	Usage:
4	    uv run python -m etf_risk.spark_pipeline --windows data/windows/full-2026-10-12/rolling-252-s21
5	    (for timed runs, start it through etf_risk.measure, which also records peak memory)
6	
7	Input:  a window-definition folder from etf_risk.windows (windows.parquet + config.json) and
8	        the return files of the snapshot named in its config. Every SHA-256 recorded in the
9	        config is verified before Spark starts; a mismatch stops the run.
10	Output: data/outputs/windows/<snapshot>/<definitions name>/<run id>/
11	          window_stats/   one row per window, from returns and prices only (no model)
12	          path_days/      one row per (window, leverage, day), partitioned by ticker
13	          path_summary/   one row per (window, leverage)
14	          paired/         one row per window, 1x and 2x side by side
15	          checks.json     violation counts of the full-scale checks
16	          run.json        configuration, checksums, Spark settings, timings, counts, status
17	
18	How the work is split (docs/spec.md, sections 6 and 7):
19	  - window members: each definition is exploded into its rows and joined to a
20	    broadcast of the returns (about 39k rows).
21	  - model: groupBy(window key).applyInPandas sorts each window by date, checks it is
22	    complete, and runs model.simulate_path for every leverage on the same returns,
23	    so 1x and 2x always share their input.
24	  - summaries: Spark aggregations written separately from model.summarize_path, so
25	    comparing the two (etf_risk.verify) is a real check.
26	  - pairing: conditional aggregation on the window key, never a join on ticker only.
27	  - null rule: Spark's sum/avg/min/max skip nulls, so every aggregate carries the
28	    count of terms it used and is null unless that count is complete.
29	
30	Exit codes: 0 all checks passed, 1 a check failed, 2 the run failed, 3 checksum error.
31	
32	AI contribution: written with Claude Code (Opus 5.5). Verified with
33	tests/test_spark_equivalence.py (including failure injection) and by the
34	sample comparison in etf_risk.verify on the stride-21 run.
35	"""

86	PAIR_SQL = """
87	SELECT window_kind, ticker, window_days, entry_date,
88	       COUNT(*)                                                AS n_paths,
89	       COUNT(DISTINCT leverage)                                AS n_leverages,
90	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 1.0 THEN total_return END)     AS return_1x,
91	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN total_return END)     AS return_2x,
92	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 1.0 THEN max_drawdown END)     AS mdd_1x,
93	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN max_drawdown END)     AS _mdd_2x,
94	       BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN leverage = 1.0 THEN breached END)     AS breached_1x,
95	       BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN breached END)     AS breached_2x,
96	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN breach_date END)      AS breach_date_2x,
97	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN breach_day END)       AS breach_day_2x,
98	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN last_ok_date END)     AS last_ok_date_2x,
99	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN days_ok END)          AS days_ok_2x,
100	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN mean_turnover END)    AS _mean_turnover_2x,
101	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN max_turnover END)     AS _max_turnover_2x,
102	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN total_turnover END)   AS _total_turnover_2x,
103	       MAX(CASE WHEN leverage = 2.0 THEN n_turnover_days END)  AS n_turnover_days_2x

109	def build_spark(master: str = "local[*]", shuffle_partitions: int | None = None) -> SparkSession:
110	    # Without this, Spark binds to the Wi-Fi interface on macOS.
111	    os.environ.setdefault("SPARK_LOCAL_IP", "127.0.0.1")
112	    builder = (
113	        SparkSession.builder.master(master)
114	        .appName("etf-risk")

120	    spark = builder.getOrCreate()
121	    spark.sparkContext.setLogLevel("ERROR")
